tasks.title: Semantic landmark review (HTML01)
tasks.statement: Build a page with a header, main containing an h1 and a section, and a footer. Use semantic elements only.
tasks.expected:
Site header
Landmarks
Section content.
Site footer

debug.title: Missing main landmark (HTML01)
debug.error: No main landmark: assistive tech cannot jump to the primary content.

interview.q: Why does the main landmark matter for assistive technology? (HTML01)
interview.answer: It gives screen readers a single entry point to the primary content, letting users skip repeated navigation and reach the page’s core topic quickly.
